questions: Does each vertex appear exactly once across all N paths, or can vertices be reused across different paths?
Are the paths required to be vertex-disjoint, edge-disjoint, or neither?
Is the order of vertices in each path significant, or only the set of edges?
Can a path be a simple path (no repeated vertices), or are walks allowed?
If vertex reuse is allowed, can an edge be used in multiple paths?
Does 'length K' mean K edges (so K+1 vertices) or K vertices (so K-1 edges)?
Are the paths required to cover all edges of the tree, or just all vertices?
Is the tree rooted or unrooted for the decomposition?
